lede: Complete engine rebuild service for all Land Rover models — from classic Defenders to modern Range Rovers. Carried out at our specialist Essex workshop.

sections.heading: What Our Engine Rebuild Service Involves

blocks.html: A full engine rebuild returns your Land Rover's engine to factory specification or better. We strip the engine completely, inspect every component, machine critical surfaces, and reassemble with new bearings, piston rings, seals, and gaskets. The result is an engine that performs like new and carries a [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/warranty).

This service applies across the entire Land Rover range — from classic 200Tdi and Td5 engines in Defenders and Discoveries, through TDV6/SDV6 units in later models, to modern Ingenium diesel and petrol engines in the latest Range Rovers, Defenders, and Discoverys. We also cover AJ133 supercharged V8s in performance models and BMW-sourced V8s in the Defender Octa.
Prices are all-inclusive (parts, labour, machining, and final testing) with no hidden extras. Final costs depend on the specific engine and any unforeseen wear discovered during strip-down.
We rebuild engines across the full Land Rover line-up. Click a model to see detailed variant and engine information.

steps.title: Arrival & Assessment
steps.body: Vehicle arrives at our Essex workshop. We inspect the engine bay, check fluid levels, and discuss the vehicle's history with you.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: All systems are drained, ancillaries disconnected, and the engine is carefully lifted from the vehicle and mounted on a rotating stand.

steps.title: Strip-Down & Inspection
steps.body: Complete disassembly: heads, timing components, pistons, and crankshaft are removed. Every part is measured and inspected for wear.

steps.title: Machining & Preparation
steps.body: Cylinder bores are honed or bored oversize, crankshaft journals ground, and cylinder heads resurfaced. All oil galleries are flushed.

steps.title: Assembly (Rebuild)
steps.body: New bearings, piston rings, seals, and gaskets are fitted. Timing components are installed and set precisely to manufacturer specification.

steps.title: Testing & Reinstallation
steps.body: Engine is test-run on stand, checked for oil pressure and leaks. Then reinstalled, fluids filled, and a full road test is conducted.

steps.body: Contact us via phone, WhatsApp, or the quote form with your vehicle details.
We arrange recovery or workshop drop-off at our Essex facility.
We inspect your engine and provide a fixed-price rebuild quote.
Upon approval, we carry out the rebuild, test, and road-test the vehicle.
You collect your Land Rover with a 12-month warranty and full documentation.

items.q: How long does a Land Rover engine rebuild take?
items.a: Our standard rebuild turnaround is **3-5 working days** from arrival at our workshop. This is shorter than many industry benchmarks because we keep parts in stock and carry out machining in-house.

items.q: What's included in the rebuild price?
items.a: Our fixed-price quotes include: full strip-down and inspection, all new bearings, piston rings, seals, gaskets, timing components (where needed), machining (boring, honing, grinding, head resurfacing), assembly, testing, and reinstallation. [Full pricing disclaimer here](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on rebuilt engines?
items.a: Yes. Every engine rebuild comes with a **12-month unlimited-mileage warranty** covering parts and labour. The warranty is backed by Engine Finders UK Ltd.

items.q: Can you rebuild my engine if the vehicle isn't running?
items.a: Yes. We offer nationwide recovery services — we can collect your non-running Land Rover and bring it to our workshop for inspection and rebuild. [Learn more about our recovery service →](/landrover-engine-recovery)

items.q: Do you use genuine or aftermarket parts?
items.a: We use a combination of OEM-spec and high-quality aftermarket parts, always matching the original manufacturer's specification. For critical components (bearings, timing chains, gaskets), we source from JLR-approved suppliers or established specialist manufacturers.
